entities.summary: Andrei Vladimirovich Tarasenko was a Russian ice hockey player and coach. He participated in the 1994 Winter Olympics, where his team secured a fourth-place finish. He played in eight games and scored two goals. After retiring he worked as the head coach and then senior coach with Sibir Novosibirsk, the club he played for in 1984–1986 and 2001–2003.
